title: Putting God First With Our Resources

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Be sure to set aside a tenth of all that your fields produce each year. Eat the tithe of your grain, new wine and olive oil, and the firstborn of your herds and flocks in the presence of the Lord your God at the place he will choose as a dwelling for his Name, so that you may learn to revere the Lord your God always. - Deut 14:22-23 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God instructs Israel to set aside a tenth — a tithe — of their produce each year and bring it before Him. And notice the stated purpose: "so that you may learn to revere the Lord your God always." The tithe was not merely about God needing their grain and wine. It was a practice designed to shape their hearts, teaching them to put God first and to hold their resources with open hands. Giving was a form of spiritual training in reverence and trust.

There is deep wisdom here about the relationship between our hearts and our resources. What we do with our money and possessions reveals and shapes what we truly value. By giving God the first and best portion, Israel was regularly reminded that everything they had came from Him and belonged to Him. Generous giving loosens the grip of greed and trains the heart to trust God as provider. It teaches reverence in a very practical way.

The New Testament calls believers to give generously, cheerfully, and sacrificially, though it emphasizes the heart over a strict percentage: "Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give... for God loves a cheerful giver" (2 Cor 9:7). The principle endures: putting God first with our resources trains our hearts to revere Him and trust His provision. This is not a prosperity transaction where we give to get rich; it is a discipline that frees us from the tyranny of money and deepens our trust in God. How you handle your resources shapes your heart. Give with open hands, and learn to revere the Lord always.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- What does the way I handle money reveal about what I truly value?
- Does my giving train my heart to trust God and hold resources with open hands?
- How can generous giving free me from the grip of greed?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, everything I have comes from You and belongs to You. Teach me to put You first with my resources, holding them with open hands. Free me from the grip of greed, and let generous giving train my heart to revere You and trust Your provision always. Amen.
